description: Changes one layer from get_timeline: move, scale or rotate it, its text, colour or visibility, a footage layer's times, or the picture or clip it shows. Only what its can list allows. Saves a new version, all or nothing; restore_version undoes it. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since. Left out: the live version, and a repeat is saved once.

hidden.description: true hides it, false shows it again.

layer_id.description: A layer id from get_timeline (not an ov_ overlay: those change with put_overlay).

x.description: Across, in the layer's units (from get_timeline).

layout.description: Move, scale or rotate it; null puts its own place back.

media_end.description: Footage or clip layer: the film second it ends.

media_source_in.description: Footage or clip layer: the second of its media it plays from.

media_start.description: Footage or clip layer: the film second it starts.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A Short, hook or shape of the video; the main video when left out.

replace_asset_id.description: Picture or clip layer: show this asset_id instead; null puts its own back.

restore.description: true puts its own text, colour and visibility back.

text.description: New words, where it can take text.

name: update_layer

outputSchema.description: Clypmint update_layer result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change a layer
